caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded stoneware jug with a narrow neck and a small handle attached to the upper portion near the spout. The jug is predominantly light gray or beige in color, with some darker speckled areas and shading to indicate curvature and texture. The front of the jug bears a large decorative blue motif, resembling two interlocking loops or an infinity symbol, flanked by stylized blue leaves on either side. Below the motif, there is an inscription in blue uppercase letters reading: "COMMERAW'S STONEWARE CORLEARS HOOK N. YORK." In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, inset illustration showing a close-up side view of the handle with the same color and style. The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background with faint rectilinear borders.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
